text_block_list.text:
"Wah! Amazing... To think there's a view like this
just a short walk away..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...
If I just follow this river downstream, where will I end up, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, walking on rocks in an outfit like this
is a bit too much...
choice_data_list: Shall we turn back here, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I want to keep going like this.
Since we've already come this far."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I want to look for good footing,
and see how far I can go."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Aha, the ocean...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm actually a little moved.
I mean, of course rivers lead to the ocean, but...
It's like, wow, it's actually real.
choice_data_list: Since we're here, wanna go down to the water's edge?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'll try!
I already decided I'd go as far as I possibly can.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's cold!
Though, it actually feels pretty nice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hermit crabs are gathering!
...I wonder if there's something over by those rocks?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's dark and atmospheric, but... in manga and stuff,
something wonderful always washes ashore in places like this, right?
Even after that, we strolled wherever Mejiro Dober's interest led her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm totally beat...
Maybe I played around a bit too much.
choice_data_list: We played more than twice as much as usual today, huh.
We played more than twice as much as usual today, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...You're pretty patient to tag along with me.
You could've just gone home halfway through."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Aha, yeah.
Thanks for coming with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
These... clothes today...
Ryan gave them to me as a present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: When I was fretting over something trivial, this outfit was sent to me along with a letter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They told me I should have more confidence
and just have as much fun as possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She cheered me up with a letter like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember when we talked about
going down the river?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "If it were the usual me, I probably would have turned back right then and there."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even so... I managed to take that first step.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Somehow,
it feels like someone is giving me a push from behind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"And so, I ended up here.
Finding so many new things has been so exciting."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, wearing these clothes made me feel like...
maybe I could go anywhere.
choice_data_list: So that means Ryan's wish came true.
So Ryan's wish came true, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Well, maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You think so? ...I hope that's true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm glad I'll be able to give a good report.

Report?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
With this, I think I'll have some good news to report!

text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to report to Ryan
about what happened where we went today."

Huh? Was I really that hyped—... Oh, I guess I was.
You're right... ahaha...

you're truly enjoying yourself...?
